svg.aria-label: Davit Toroyan, full-stack developer in Yerevan, Armenia. Full-stack developer who builds web products in React, Next.js, and TypeScript and automates the work around them. 3+ years at a digital agency: web apps with catalogs, forms, and admin panels, online stores, and deploys and monitoring on GitHub Actions. I build with AI coding tools every day and test every change myself before it ships. I keep up with a fast-moving field, AI above all, and bring what proves itself into real work: the Next.js App Router, typed validation with Zod, automated pipelines, and AI agents in my daily workflow.
